I've had so many ads shoved in my face that I assumed the transition at 3:54 was a sponsor spot. I was going to be upset at how much the sponsor integrated with the real content, but I really appreciate that your sponsor spot opened cold at 10:37, without one of those annoying transitions that make it impossible to tell where the real content ends and where the advertising starts. Thank you. I've only recently started to use AI in my work, and I've found that it's good for very niche use cases. For those use cases it's dramatically better than any other tool available, but it's still a tool that needs to be used with purpose and intent. I'm' tired of all the AI bros saying that AGI is coming soon (it's not) and I'm tired of all the "doom trolling" those companies are doing. Thank you for the balanced and rational perspective. I think everyone should check out Cal Newport's article on "doom trolling", because it's a very good perspective on modern AI tools.
The study Catherine mentions actually said that *any* AI use, no matter how tiny, made its users immediately dumber, and the effect lingered long after they stopped using AI. Worth keeping in mind.
